# Browser runtime notices

The static demo redistributes unmodified [Pyodide 314.0.6](https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/314.0.6), including its CPython 3.14.2 runtime, from the locked npm package. Pyodide is licensed under MPL-2.0; its corresponding source is available at that versioned link. CPython and its included components retain the notices in `CPYTHON-LICENSE.txt` (from CPython v3.14.2). The original application remains Apache-2.0; that license does not replace third-party licenses.

`PYODIDE-LICENSE.txt` is copied from the pinned Pyodide source. `CPYTHON-LICENSE.txt` is copied from the pinned CPython source. Runtime dependencies are served from the same static site. The normal Python wheel does not bundle Pyodide. React and React DOM are MIT-licensed; their unmodified license texts are retained here and copied into the static demo.
